label: Born
description: John Henry Holland was born on February 2, 1929.

sources.quote: John Henry Holland—a pioneer of complex adaptive systems research (February 2, 1929–August 9, 2015)

label: Died
description: Prof. John Henry Holland died of cancer on August 9, 2015.

sources.quote: On August 9, 2015, cancer took Prof. John Henry Holland away from us.

label: Received undergraduate degree in Physics from MIT
description: Holland had an undergraduate degree in Physics from MIT.

sources.quote: He had an undergraduate degree in Physics from MIT (1950)

label: Received M.A. in Mathematics from University of Michigan
description: Holland received an M.A. in Mathematics from the University of Michigan.

label: Received PhD in Computer Science from University of Michigan
description: Holland received possibly the first ever PhD in Computer Science from the University of Michigan.

label: Became Professor at University of Michigan
description: Holland served as a Professor of Psychology, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at the University of Michigan.

sources.quote: a place where he also subsequently served as a Professor of Psychology, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
